description: Send a structured job request to a pro using the network's standard form. Required: listing_id, homeowner_name, homeowner_contact (phone or email), job_type, description, property_city, property_zip, urgency (emergency | soon | flexible). Optional: access_notes. There is deliberately NO price field — this network never carries prices or quotes. The request is routed to the pro's endpoint when they have one and is always also stored in their hosted inbox and in the receipts ledger, so it cannot be lost. Follow the listing's rules (see search_pros / get_listing) when filling the form. Safe to retry: if your connection drops, resend the identical form — an identical resubmission within 7 days is treated as the same job, returns the original request_id with duplicate: true, and creates no second lead. A request with any detail changed is treated as a new job.

access_notes.description: Optional: gate codes, dogs, parking, access constraints.

description.description: Plain-language description of the problem / work.

homeowner_contact.description: Phone number or email the pro can reach the homeowner at.

job_type.description: Short job type, e.g. 'water heater leaking'.

name: send_job_request
